PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Shaper Origin is a handheld CNC router – a category of tool we invented almost a decade ago. It has the familiar form factor of a traditional router, with the precision of a high-end CNC machine. You steer Origin following the path on-screen, while it makes small “auto corrections” within a 1,2 cm range, leaving you with perfect results. Cutting joinery, profiles or patterns, and engraving for signage can all be handled directly on-tool, no programming required. It also works with almost any design software you use. So how does it work? Watch the video below.
Touch screen: Capacitive multi-touch full-color LCD.
Brushed Motor Spindle: Produced with Festool to Shaper specifications.
WiFi & USB: Over the air software updates, USB port allows easy offline transfer of design files.
Dust Port: Fits most standard 27mm & 36mm suction hoses.
Meet Origin
Origin utilizes ShaperTape (the domino looking stuff) and an on-board camera to accurately track its position while you are working.

If you can dream it, you can cut it. Achieve fully custom, tight-fitting joinery, right out of the box.

No programming required
Begin by scanning your work area. Origin automatically detects and stores this as a Workspace.
Easily create or import designs; no programming required.
Switch the spindle on and get cutting. Make changes on the fly to adjust for real-world fit. Origin autocorrects your movements so you get perfect results.
An Integrated System

from design to fabrication.

Getting Started Guide
Quick Start Guide, Usage and Safety Instructions, and Regulatory Information for Origin Gen 2
These instructions apply only to Origin Gen 2 (date of purchase on or after October 27, 2022). You can tell which generation your Origin belongs to by the serial number located on the side of your tool. It begins with either SO1 (Gen 1) or SO2 (Gen 2).
The Origin Gen 1 manual can be found here.
Here you will find all currently available languages of the Quick Guide as well as the Safety Guide for Origin Gen 2.
